album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 1

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B2 and dwells most on F in Dobeyti. The line peaks at G4 (389.1 Hz) at 0:02.9. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → C4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → Eb4).
